items.title: Renew Manchester business license
items.authority: City of Manchester City Clerk, Business Licensing and Enforcement
items.description: Licenses are obtained from the City Clerk; the licensing year begins May 1 and licenses expire April 30 of the following year.

penalty.note: The city's application says late applications may be charged a late charge but does not state the amount.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Nashua
items.description: Use the cited official state business resource as a starting point, then confirm city and county licensing requirements before operating.

feeDetail.note: The fee depends on the type of business and license; the city or county sets it in its fee schedule.

penalty.note: The state page this entry cites gives no penalty amount.
